Morgan: Seeing a perf regression on Llama3 13B after yesterday's rollout — p95 token latency up ~30%.
Sasha: any logs or profiler output?
Morgan: profiler dump attached below, kernel selector flipped to slow path under medium batches.
Morgan: ```
2026-03-31T12:03:54Z [selector] chosen_kernel=generic_gemm size=384 head_dim=128 reason=aligned_mismatch
2026-03-31T12:03:54Z [runtime] kv_cache_hits=0.12 kv_evictions=0.08 batch_size=4 seq_len=512
2026-03-31T12:03:54Z [op] fallback_path=vectorized_slow
```
Raj: hm looks like head_dim mismatch + seq_len spike. Any model config changes? rope_theta maybe?
Keiko: We shipped a ropetheta tweak in the L2/3 config for stability; could change effective token interactions and cache locality.
Sasha: also saw chat-template pads increase prefix length for some clients -> smaller effective batch shapes which triggers prefetch fallback.
perf-bot: alert: recent commit 9f3c -> kernel_selector refactor (rollout 2026-03-30 22:40 UTC)
Morgan: repro steps I'm running: `PYTEST_PERF=1 ./tools/perf_harness --model llama3-13b --seq 512 --batch 4 --trace kernel_selector`
Raj: try forcing kernel selector debug: `KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1 ROPETHETA_OVERRIDE=0.00027 ./tools/perf_harness` — compare chosen kernels.
Keiko: quick hypothesis: ropetheta change makes attention weights less local -> KV cache gets fewer hits and batcher chooses conservative, high-overhead kernel. Also RMSNorm vs SiLU toggles can change op fusion choices.
Sasha: can you paste a flamegraph link from the profiler? need to see time in memcpy vs kernel compute.
Morgan: uploaded flamegraph: https://internal.perf/fg/1769301234
Raj: assignment: I'll open a perf/regress issue, collect traces, and run A/B with old ropetheta and new. If we confirm, revert ropetheta or add special-case kernel for head_dim=128/stride=64.
Keiko: also add a chat-template test to CI to lock prefix-pad distributions so batching heuristics don't regress silently.
perf-bot: created issue INF-2026 with traces and perf tags
Morgan: thanks — I'll run the full run and drop the profiler artifacts in the issue. :thumbsup:
Sasha: cool. ping me once INF-2026 has prod logs and kernel selector trace.
Raj: I'll take the first pass tomorrow morning.
